landing.title: Rovaniemi cycling routes on one map
landing.lead: Gravel, trail, road, touring and winter – pick your bike and the map shows the routes that suit it, with difficulty, surfaces and GPX files.
landing.allRoutes: Open the map with all routes
landing.shareNote: Your choice is remembered, and the address can be shared:
landing.videoHelp: The video is silent and only shown on a fast connection. Pausing is remembered on this device.
landing.aboutText1: The routes were ridden and described by local cyclists. This is not a municipal service: nobody plows, marks or inspects the routes for this site, and conditions change with the weather.
landing.aboutText2: Some routes use paths maintained by the municipality or another party, some do not. A route card tells you when there is no maintenance, with this notice:
landing.noticeSample: this is what the notice looks like
landing.promise1Text: Every route has a GPX file for your bike computer or phone. The map also works while you ride.
landing.promise2Text: Difficulty is given in words and as an ITRS grade, never as color alone. Climbs and lengths come from the recorded track.
landing.promise3Text: The route card shows how much is asphalt, gravel and trail, and where you share the road with cars.
landing.promise4Text: A fallen tree, a new fence or a wrong surface? Every route has a button for reporting a correction.
landing.sourcesText: Map data and surface information come from open sources. Route tracks and descriptions are the riders' own. Sources and their retrieval dates:
landing.source2: © National Land Survey of Finland, topographic map (CC BY 4.0)
landing.source3: © Natural Resources Institute Finland, harvest forecasts
landing.disclaimerText: You ride the routes at your own risk. Check the conditions, respect nature and landowners, and give way to pedestrians.
landing.footerNote: Not a municipal service. You ride at your own risk.
